lines.say: Push-ups. Can they build as much muscle as the bench press?
Push-ups work your chest, shoulders and triceps, like the bench.
Plus your core has to hold your body straight.
In one study, push-ups and bench press at a similar effort gave similar strength gains.
The catch: you have to make them hard enough.
Too easy? Slow them down, raise your feet, or add a backpack.
